verdict.rationale: The Pydantic AI Gateway issues a single API key for multiple models with "real-time monitoring and budget control," which hints at limiting what an agent's credential can spend. Nothing shows per-agent keys scoped to specific models, tools, or permissions, and "one key for all your models" points toward broad rather than least-privilege access. Missing for 10: documented per-agent credential issuance, permission/model scoping on keys, key revocation or rotation, and any independent corroboration.
